documentationSearch.result: deposited H5TD columns, expressions, characters, reconstructed trees; no column-construction code in raw metadata
public visualization website; not the raw annotation pipeline
source-study Methods explicitly describe field construction

cell_type.construction: reference expression label transfer, marker-guided manual curation, automated annotation, then grouping
cell_type.features: filtered5000 HVGs/scVI clustering; local/global marker genes; exact per-label feature list not recovered
cell_type.locator: PDF pp73-74, Cell type annotation and Embedding with scVI
cell_type.relationships: measured separately in field_relationships.json; do not infer undocumented mappings

germ_layer.construction: annotated transcriptional subtypes receive germ-layer/domain labels
germ_layer.features: subtype labels, not independently measured germ-layer identity
germ_layer.relationships: measured separately in field_relationships.json; do not infer undocumented mappings

phase.construction: curated S-phase and G2/M expression scores; exact phase-calling implementation not deposited here
phase.features: curated S/G2M gene sets; exact list PROVENANCE_NOT_IDENTIFIED
phase.locator: PDF p73, Normalization and highly-variable gene selection
phase.relationships: measured separately in field_relationships.json; do not infer undocumented mappings

type.construction: LTC expression and transcriptome SNP thresholds, doublet exclusion
type.features: LTC UMIs, transcriptome UMIs, host SNPs; Xist in specified doublet checks
type.locator: PDF p70, Identification of donor, host, and doublet cells
type.relationships: measured separately in field_relationships.json; do not infer undocumented mappings

historicalWitnessClass: annotation-based descriptive calibration; not transcriptome-independent validation of developmental memory
orthogonalMeasurement: obsm/characters records lineage marks from targeted LTC readout; orthogonal molecular modality to expression but the same information used to reconstruct H, not an independent phenotype or future outcome
sourceVersion: bioRxiv v1, May9 2026; read Methods pp70,73,74; current public v2 paper also indexed by PMC13174701
